text: Hi, this is Biscuit, a four year old beagle. He has been vomiting since yesterday and eating less.
He weighs 12.5 kilograms today. Temperature 38.9. Gums are pink and a bit tacky, so mildly dehydrated.
Belly is soft and not painful. I think this is mild gastritis, probably from something he ate.
We'll give maropitant today, a bland diet for three days, and recheck if he vomits again.
